# TS02-C2 — Stage-2 client orchestration — non-fungibles

## What it is for

The client surface for non-fungible collections — issuing, minting, traits, sets and transfers.

Talos is the only supported client path and the only gas-funded one. See `10-architecture/01-the-layer-cake.md`.

## Where it sits

Above the collectables family.

## Traps

**Non-fungible quantity is fixed at one**, so the operations here differ from their semi-fungible twins in more than a flag.
